decision: RIGHTS REVIEW HOLD — not deployed, not merged. AGCO PDF yields 222 dates in the reviewed technical extraction, but the PDF's automated-access and normalized-data redistribution permissions are not established. The proposed Ontario Standardbred Woodbine Mohawk Park C-level collector must remain disabled / unmerged; Standardbred Canada must remain reference-only absent permission. No Canada-wide completeness claim.

rights_review.required_evidence: Source-specific license or written rights-holder authorization for automated retrieval and public display of normalized date+venue records, plus attribution/access conditions; or replacement with a source having those explicit grants.
rights_review.note: The Ontario Data Catalogue 'Horse race dates' dataset is under review; it is not proven to be the same work as the AGCO PDF and does not establish a licence.
